[LSTO.3.2.1] `persist: <dur>` on a series declaration forwards every
sampled value to the samples plane. `<dur>` is the raw
retention window; older samples are downsampled or
archived per runtime policy. Without `persist:`, the
series stays live-only. The integrator wires the actual
sample destination via a dedicated callback per
[NSTG.5];
the engine does not assume a specific backend shape.
